predictions.articleTitle: Argentina vs Uruguay Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Uruguay Exploit Hosts' Post-Messi Absences?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Depleted across defense and attack in their first post-Messi outing, Argentina face a tight, low-scoring test where Uruguay can avoid defeat via Draw / Away Win.
possibilityAssessment: Draw / Away Win anchored on a 1:1 stalemate and 0:1 transition upset given near-even 1.20 vs 1.05 goal lambdas and heavy Argentine absences (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Under 2.5 Goals driven by 2.25 combined goal expectancy, missing frontline finishers on both sides, and strict officiating tempo (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Tight 1:0 home grind if Argentina's Mac Allister-Enzo Fernández midfield pins back Uruguay's Ugarte-less screen early (Confidence: Low, Value: Low)
